Mauthenga, mauthenga a mawu ndi mafoni ndi anthu amene mumalumikizana nawo. Aliyense amalemba ndi kulankhula m'chilankhulo chake, mnzake amalandira m'chake.

Kuposa kwambiri pulogalamu: {OW} ikufuna kukhala pakati pa kusinthana kwa dziko lonse. Kulankhula, kuphunzira, kugula, kugulitsa, kugwira ntchito, kudziwana: aliyense m'chilankhulo chake.
Lero, kumasulira kumagwira ntchito mkati mwa {OW}. Kuilumikiza ndi njira zina zolankhulirana ndi njira imene tikutsatira.
Mbiri yanu ndi chithunzi chanu zimaoneka kokha kwa anthu amene mumalumikizana nawo.

Inapangidwa ku France ndi woyambitsa wake, popanda zotsatsa.
Cholinga chathu: pakati pa kusinthana kwa dziko lonse, kuti aliyense, kulikonse kumene ali, athe kulankhula, kuphunzira ndi kuchita bizinesi ndi dziko lonse.
Mafoni a kanema omasuliridwa, okhala ndi mawu olembedwa m'chilankhulo chanu.
Gulitsani, gulani ndi kuchita bizinesi ndi dziko lonse, aliyense m'chilankhulo chake. Malonda a pa intaneti, ndipo mawa kuphunzira za misika.
Khalani m'gulu la amene anayamba. Itanani munthu wapafupi, ndipo pamodzi tipangitse dziko kulankhula.
